_meta.purpose: CL-PHYS-03 §4 evaluation-layer venue opening hours. The evaluation layer injects a REQUIRED `venue_hours_policy` gate for every opportunity_id present here: an hour bucket whose LOCAL start is outside [open, close) can never become a 推薦. The pinned canonical opportunity records under data/v2/opportunities/ are never edited for this.
policy: A venue absent from this table is UNKNOWN, never assumed open: the gate is simply not injected (abstain). Hours are never invented to make a gate fire.
Every entry must carry source_kind + source + retrieved_at so the table can be audited.

Hours are the venue's LOCAL civil clock; [open, close) is half-open and the judged instant is the hour bucket START. Overnight windows (close <= open) are treated as malformed and abstain (UNKNOWN), never guessed.
confirmed_by is the owner ticket that asserted the window; a table row without confirmed_by is not authoritative.
provenance_rules: Two provenance shapes are accepted and every row must say which one it is via source_kind. There is no third shape, and 'well-known' opening hours are never one of them.
sourced_venue_page: the hours were READ from a page and the row names it — URL + retrieved_at. A row may not claim this kind without a URL.

owner_asserted: the owner asserted the window in a ticket and no page was read for it. Accepted as a source ONLY when the row carries BOTH confirmed_by (the asserting ticket id) and asserted_at (the date the owner asserted it); source_kind MUST then be exactly owner_asserted, and source must state plainly that no URL was supplied and none is invented. Such a row is a ticket assertion, not URL-verified provenance: do not cite it as one, and convert it to sourced_venue_page if/when an official page is read.
A row that claims sourced_venue_page without a URL, or owner_asserted without confirmed_by + asserted_at, is a policy violation — not a judgement call.

The evaluation gate judges the hour on the PLACE's local clock, derived from the place coordinate's UTC offset. The `timezone` field on an entry is NOT read by the gate: it is kept for future use and labelled timezone_unused=true so the next reader does not trust it as the gate's clock.

tw-151-P02.gate_consequence_note: The venue window gates EVERY opportunity at this place, including this one, whose genre is firefly — a night subject. Under the asserted 08:00-17:00 window no hour of a firefly (dusk/night) subject can pass the venue gate, so this opportunity is currently suppressed rather than recommended. That is the honest consequence of the owner's assertion and is deliberately NOT worked around here (no genre exemption, no invented dusk window): if the firefly subject should publish, the owner must supply the actual dusk entry hours or the venue's night-access policy.
